title: conditional financing
context: Other contestant requests capital during a wager sequence; daughter has an interest in contest.
observed_actions: Provides financing subject to a return condition.
observed_result: Creates a new obligation and incentive relationship.
epistemic_limits: Funding requires actual resources; no unconditional willingness.
information_available: Other contestant requests capital during a wager sequence; daughter has an interest in contest.
counterfactual_test: A skilled rival asks for money but your family member wants to compete. Negotiates terms and weighs family interests against risk. Reject: Invents funds or ignores repayment terms.
